serverUrl.description: Base URL of the Willow connect service, e.g. https://acme.mcp-s.com. Used to evaluate Claude.ai messages and file uploads against org guards.

authToken.description: Org HMAC token in '{orgSlug}:{signature}' format, used as the Bearer token when calling the connect guard adapter.

guardMessages.description: When true, user messages sent on Claude.ai are evaluated against org guards before being sent.

guardFiles.description: When true, files uploaded on Claude.ai are evaluated against org guards before being sent.
